title: Utility types
explain: Utility types build new types from existing ones so you don't repeat yourself. `Partial` makes every property optional, `Pick` and `Omit` select or drop properties, and `Record` builds an object type from keys and a value type. `Readonly` and `Required` flip those flags across a whole type.
exercise: Given a `Todo` interface, create a type for updating a todo where every field is optional except `id`.
tip: `Partial` is shallow. Nested objects inside stay exactly as they were, so deep updates may need your own recursive type.
